authority.owner_request: Inspect TrafficTwin project records, identify the due dissertation experiment, and launch substantial needed computation on CSF3; use project records and keep doing.
authority.interpretation: Owner authorizes this newly recorded E3a-only campaign and its engineering qualification. Historical holds and no-results records remain immutable historical evidence. No E3b/E3c execution or main-branch release is included.
authority.scope: The exact dormant E3a design: twelve fixed_1x fresh-state placement cells. This additive package implements real trace adaptation of its P2C contract in the established float32 evaluator. It does not claim execution of the dormant 56-cell matrix.

statistics.replicates: four matched fleet draws; individual tasks are not replicates; evaluator seed is held at zero
statistics.estimate: mean of four treatment-minus-control draw differences
statistics.interval: paired Student-t 95% interval, df=3, critical value 3.182446305284263, sample SD divided by sqrt(4)
statistics.multiplicity: one predeclared primary comparison; secondary is descriptive and its interval is unadjusted
statistics.incomplete: Any missing or invalid cell makes its matched contrast incomplete; never reduce n, pool tasks, impute zero, or use qualification runs as extra draws.
statistics.hypothesis: P2C may approach global per-task placement deadline attainment; negative, null and opposite results remain valid.

before_replay: independent exact pushed source SHA approval
external SHA pin of complete source/input/reference manifest
sequence: 10-step incident smoke for each arm, fleet_seed=1/evaluator_seed=0
3600-step incident benchmark for each arm with the same seeds
twelve full campaign cells after qualification passes
qualification.references: Archived September 7 incident ingress10, ingress3600 and per_task3600; receipt hashes must authenticate all reference outputs before comparison.
qualification.comparison: qualification_reference.py fixes tolerances before replay; integer/bool arrays, mode choices, admission, selected targets, outcomes and count/ratio summaries exact; actor logits absolute tolerance 1e-5; endpoint queues 0.1ms; accumulated latency sums 1ms + 1e-4 relative; other task floats 0.001ms + 1e-6 relative.

machine_plan.order: fleet seeds ascending; ingress_dla, per_task_dla, p2c_dla within each fleet seed
machine_plan.minimum_free_space: 20 GiB plus twice projected twelve-cell raw output bytes

claim_boundaries: Simulation under one recorded incident trace, fixed trained actor and four fleet draws; no independent traffic traces or evaluator seeds.
P2C enumerates all RSUs for feasibility. Pair-only ranking does not establish two total reads or communication savings.
Comparator rejection categories and P2C N0 rejection taxonomy differ; total rejection is comparable, category contrasts are mechanism diagnostics.
Latency is the inherited admission-time estimate; physical compute completion, returned results and drops remain unavailable rather than zero.
Fixed compute units imply 36000 resource-unit-seconds per full cell; this is normalized provisioned capacity including idle time, not monetary cost.
E3 scaling/staleness and MAPPO retraining remain outside this campaign. Existing dissertation studies stay complete and unchanged.
